title: an object cannot do Error, even with text()
purpose: Errors are error enums; an object declaring does Error is rejected.

failure.justification: The contract makes this an error without fixing the detection stage; static analysis may reject it, otherwise execution fails. The program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 9.5: only error enums (and the system NativeFailure) are errors; an object declaring does Error is a semantic error.
